purpose: Provides structured network utilities without relying on bash commands - pure Python implementation for cross-platform network diagnostics

parameters.operation: Type of network operation to perform
parameters.host: Target hostname or IP address (required for ping, dns, port, traceroute)
parameters.port: Target port number (required for port operation)
parameters.count: Number of ping packets to send (default: 4)
parameters.test_hosts: List of hosts to test for connectivity check
